race.comment: Another one where conditions will be a factor but RUN HARRY RUN (3) should take plenty of catching. He was dominant winning a Vobis race at Cranbourne last start and looks to get a fairly soft time up on speed which will be key against a few rivals. Heavy ground is the worry but he hasn't had much exposure to it. KING ZEPHYR (7) is a tough one. He was very good on heavy ground at Flemington fresh which is usually something he hasn't handled, but then he was plain over 1400m on drier ground last time. He does fly here at Sandown and the cutaway potentially offsets traffic issues from barrier one, but he does need another win. RAMADAN (2) is the big watch, off nearly two years. Didn't fire in a few Hong Kong runs but he's a G2 winner in France and soft ground will help. He bolted in with a recent jumpout, watch the market. HERE TO SHOCK (1) struggled last time but is an each way hope on prior. RECON (6) is a query on wet but going well, watch the market with wet-tracker PUNCH LANE (4).
